subject: Next steps on procurement path — PO vs card & marketplace option
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@glowhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + procurement path questions from today's discovery

Hi Dana — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and two asks so we can line up procurement: 

- Scope we discussed: pilot for Patient Summaries (up to 10k monthly generation tokens) + embeddings for search.
- Target go-live: mid-April if onboarding paperwork and pricing approved.
- Technical owners: Alex (IT Ops) will handle networking/VPC questions; Rishi is assigned as SE.

Two procurement questions to confirm: 1) Do you prefer a PO-based purchase or will GlowHealth purchase by corporate card for the pilot? 2) Are you interested in buying via CityCloud marketplace (faster onboarding) or direct contract with Redwood?

If PO: can you share your standard vendor onboarding form (we can fill). If card: we can provide invoice/card flow for immediate start and convert to PO later.

Attached: Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf (draft scope & pricing).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync with procurement/finance next week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf]
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@glowhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Harper <alex.harper@citycloud.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@glowhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + procurement path questions from today's discovery

Hi Ben — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/ops: 

- Procurement preference: PO for anything > $5k. Pilot looks like it will sit above that, so likely PO.
- Marketplace: CityCloud marketplace would be acceptable only if vendor onboarding is completed and the invoice/terms map to our standard PO flow. We prefer a direct vendor relationship for audit controls.
- Next step: I'll send our vendor onboarding template and tax forms. We typically take 10–14 business days to process a new vendor after we receive fully completed paperwork.

Attaching the vendor onboarding spreadsheet — please have your legal/finance team complete. Also include your W-9 and contact for invoicing.

Dana
Dana Liu
Procurement Manager | GlowHealth
[dana.liu@glowhealth.com]

[Attachment: GlowHealth-vendor-onboarding.xlsx]

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + procurement path questions from today's discovery

Thanks Dana — got the onboarding sheet. We'll return it with W-9 + standard commercial terms by end of day Friday. A few clarifying items so we align: 

- If GlowHealth proceeds with a PO, lead time 10–14 business days for onboarding lines up with our expectation. For the pilot we can start configuration immediately after onboarding completes.
- Pricing impact: do you need a formal PO to lock in the pilot pricing, or will a short-term card payment reserve pricing until onboarding completes? (This matters if you want to start before PO is finalized.)
- Marketplace: understood that direct vendor is preferred for audit — we'll note that in the SOW.

Proposed next step: I can join your procurement call on Monday 02/16 at 10:00am PT to walk through the onboarding sheet and answer questions. Does that work for Alex/Procurement?

Best,
Ben

Ben — quick ops note for our internal thread before the call: 

- If GlowHealth needs to start immediately and insists on PO timeline, recommend proposing a short-term prepay via card for first month, then convert to PO for monthly billing. Legal can support a short amendment for that.
- If they insist on direct vendor (no marketplace), we should flag any onboarding fields that commonly cause delays (insurance cert, SOC 2 attestation). Rishi — can you prep answers for SOC 2, data retention, and network segmentation (Alex is expected to ask)?
- I'll prepare a one-pager on commercial flows (card prepay -> PO transition vs immediate PO) to send in the Monday call.
